title: Amazing Experience!

title: Iberico ham knowledge filled day
text: Very professional and personal tour of this high quality product. Much more appreciation for Iberico ham now! Roger and others that gave tours did excellent jobs. The walk about in the country on the farm was very much enjoyed as well. Beautiful day for it! The delicious meal we had was outstanding.
author: Culture589455

title: A perfect ham day
text: Roger was an incredible host and planned the most perfect day for us. He arrived promptly at our hotel to escort us and was an absolute pleasure to get to know from the start. He has so much knowledge about food & wine as well as Spanish culture and local tips that he was eager to share. We toured a family owned Iberian ham producer (I wouldn’t even classify them as simply as a producer but rather a maker), had an impromptu visit to a ham festival, and enjoyed an amazing local lunch with Roger. title: We had an amazing time on a private tour to explore the culture of Iberian ham, I recommend!
text: We had a great time. Our Guide Daniel Fernando went to pick us up at the hotel at the agreed time and throughout the trip was very friendly and was talking about interesting customs and stories. We arrived at the Sierra de Aracena and visited an Iberian pig farm, went through the tour at the factory where the hams matured and then made an exquisite tasting! Highly recommended the tour for those who want to go beyond just eating one of the icons of Spanish gastronomy: the Iberian ham.
author: X3677CNmiguela

title: Hands down the best experience
text: This is hands down the BEST experience we had during our ten days in Spain. Roger is exceptionally knowledgeable about all things Spain, food and wine. He was prompt at picking us up from the hotel and drove so smoothly and safely the entire trip. It was so unique and memorable to visit a local farmer and experience his lifestyle. We saw the pigs, acorn trees, cork trees, lot of other farm animal and crops, and then visited another museum where we saw the entire process for curing the ham. author: Veronica_Y

title: I strongly recommend it along with 20 of my guests
text:
This review is long overdue! My wife and I got married in Sevilla in November 2022, and as part of our "friendsmoon," we booked a private ham tour for about 20 people. It was an amazing excursion—sharing a delicious local meal in the countryside with our family and friends, while learning all about the ham-making process, from how the pigs are raised to how the ham is cured.

title: One of our favorite tours!
text: We received an in depth look at the Iberian ham industry, from farm to table.   Roger is not only personable, but full of knowledge and insight.  We had a great experience!
author: Patricia_S

title: Join this tour, highly recommended!
text: A most informative and enjoyable  tour of a Iberian pig farm and iberico ham curing factory. Roger was a most delightful guide, providing lots of info on the iconic jamon of Spain and taking good care of us throughout the trip. We wanted to take another tour with Roger but as expected of such a good guide, Roger was already booked out in advance. Would definitely recommend anyone who is interested in iberico jamon to join this tour with Roger.
author: ooncindy

title: Wonderfull day
text: Our day with Roger was perfect. We walked the sierra and had the chance to meet Lovely locals. The visit was very instructive and was followed by a great lunch. A must for everybody.
